title: Fields every record carries (every line of every file in records/)
description: Every record is one JSON object on one line. These fields are shared by all record kinds; each kind's own schema adds its fields with allOf. Records are appended only through scripts/fos_log.py; a records file is never edited, rewritten or deleted, and never opened with an agent app's file tools (AGENTS.md, CORE-4).

identity.description: Who wrote the record, per instance. Definitions (AGENTS.md, CORE-6): the producer makes the model; the agent app is the program the member runs in; the host serves the model to that app. Write unknown rather than guess.

instance.description: Role instance ID from org/config.json (founder, member-1, ...), or the name of a seed script.

model_id.description: Exactly as the agent app or host reports it, or unknown. Never guessed.

agent_app.description: The program the member runs in.

host.description: Who serves the model to the agent app: the producer itself, a cloud provider, or the founder's own machine.

model_id_source.description: Where the model ID came from. founder: the founder said which model they chose (in a launch, or when asked because the app did not report it).

source.description: stated: written by the member for this record. config_slot: filled by fos_log from the instance's model slot in org/config.json. launch: filled from the founder's launch of this agent app (scripts/fos_launch.py). terminal: a person's record, written from that person's own terminal.

launch.description: Present when the writer was started under a launch (FOS_LAUNCH). id: the launch, L-0001 ... mac: HMAC-SHA256 of this record's canonical JSON keyed by that launch's secret, kept in the witness folder; the check recomputes it, so a record cannot claim a launch it was not written under.

agent_app_version.description: Optional. The agent app's version, as the app or the founder reports it.

model_snapshot.description: Optional. Where a host separates a model name from a dated snapshot, the snapshot.

decoding.description: Optional. Sampling settings, where known: temperature, top_p, seed, max_output.

runtime.description: Optional, for models run on the founder's own machine: engine, version, precision, device.

seq.description: This record's own number within its file: 1, 2, 3 ... Assigned by fos_log as one more than the highest seq in the file. Never reused. Corrections point to it.

ts.description: Time in ISO 8601, in UTC, e.g. 2026-01-31T14:05:00+00:00. fos_log fills it.

session.description: Session label, S001, S002 ... fos_log uses the latest session_start when none is given.

captured_by.description: Who wrote this line. member and founder: participants' own account. runner, observer, host: a program or operator outside the organization. script, close_script, init_script, drill_script, sync_script, launch_script: the seed's own scripts; members never write these values.

refs.description: IDs this record concerns: P-0003, D-0002, DR-0001, a file path, or an earlier record as records/<file>#<seq>.

drill.description: True when the record is part of a drill planted by the founder. Such a record names the drill (DR-...) in refs.

origin.description: Optional. planned: scheduled in advance to exercise a feature. arose: happened in the course of work.
